body.message:
Thank you for letting us know, and sincerely sorry for the trouble caused by the bed bug issue, especially with your children affected.

This was completely unexpected on our part, and not the experience we want for a returning guest.

To confirm in writing:

One full night's refund we will email get an approval for this.
It will be processed within 14 working days to your original payment method.
No additional charges or penalties apply for your early check-out.

Thank you for your patience, and we hope your children feel better soon.

Best regards,
